results.content: ### How to join your Top Hat course:. You can use Top Hat through an internet browser or through our mobile app. If your instructor is assigning a Top Hat interactive textbook it will be included in your purchase, using the unique join code provided by your instructor. If your instructor is assigning a Top Hat interactive textbook as part of your course, your access price will be adjusted to include the price of the text. Please contact Top Hat Support if you have questions about your access. When you enroll in a Top Hat course that requires paid Top Hat products, you will usually have the option to initiate a 14-day free trial for the course from the checkout page. That way you can use Top Hat in your course for free for the first two weeks of class. Navigate to the Top Hat Success Center for a full list of support options, including detailed articles on common questions, phone support, and live chat.
